integrity: Analytic proof and exact finite arithmetic checks are included. Novelty comparison is best-knowledge, not exhaustive; independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform Cayley labeled trees and the unscaled canonical segment realization only. The result concerns expectation and one uniformly chosen facet, not surface-area concentration or area-weighted facet sampling; classical edge-division extremizers are credited as prior.
title: A Borel facet law and logarithmic mean surface-area excess for Cayley-tree graphical zonotopes
